description: Record one terminal page result for a deployment frame refresh. Every non-removed page in an initialized frame refresh must upload a newly staged desktop/mobile image pair from the exact active run, then submit those newly staged desktop/mobile version IDs and hashes with captureRunId and opaque captureProof. For unchanged, the server recomputes the image-byte hashes, accepts only an exact match to the frozen canonical pair, records the new evidence as observed, and discards the private duplicate pair; use updated if either byte hash differs. The deploy hook alone freezes removed rows, so callers cannot submit removed for an initialized run. Only server-confirmed historical pre-frame not_requested receipts retain a legacy no-run route. The server finalizes only after every initialized page has the current exact capture-run pair; a Critique queue state alone is never frame-current.

captureProof.description: Opaque proof from start_deployment_capture_run. Required with captureRunId for every initialized terminal result; never persist, log, or pass it through shell argv.

captureRunId.description: Active capture-run ID from start_deployment_capture_run. Required for every initialized frame-refresh terminal result. An initialized removed result is forbidden because the deploy hook freezes removal scope before the run; server-confirmed historical pre-frame not_requested receipts retain their legacy no-run route.

contentHashes.description: Server-recomputed SHA-256 hashes of the exact newly uploaded image bytes, paired with versionIds.

deploymentId.description: Deployment event ID supplied by get_pending_critiques.

error.description: Bounded truthful reason for failed, inaccessible, or skipped results. Never include credentials or raw page content.

outcome.description: Optional local classifier outcome. The local MCP maps changed to updated and unknown to failed when status is omitted.

pageUrl.description: Exact inventoried page URL. Query variants remain distinct.

status.description: Terminal result. Use updated for a persistent change; use failed rather than labeling uncertain evidence unchanged.

versionIds.description: Newly staged desktop/mobile version IDs for updated, added, or unchanged. Unchanged still requires fresh current-run byte uploads; the server deduplicates only after verifying both byte hashes match the frozen canonical pair.

name: record_deployment_page_result
